title: You are alone
description:
It is a story about a wife who wants to take back her scientist husband who was kidnapped by the mafia after trying to destroy his invention after the mafia learned about this invention

And also her attempt to fulfill her husband's will and destroy this invention

It is a game full of surprises and combat





I added a 6X scoop 

The red point scoop and holograph scoop, in addition to the thermal scoop, the silencer for the weapon, a quick store for ammunition, a light bell and a laser to add more fun to playing

I placed a directional arrow at the top of the screen showing the missions and how far away they are

There is a wide variety of enemies and missions that you must discover by yourself



And I set the grenade return feature where all you have to equip after you hold down the right mouse button and if you stop pressing it back in place

As for if you want to throw it, all you have to do is continue to press the right mouse button and then press the left mouse button to throw

And placed inside the game the buttons required to play

Where 1, 2, 3, and 4 are to equip the different types of weapon

And the Q button to show the attachment list

And the button w to capture

And the P button to pause

And Ctrl to crouch
